title: EffiReason-Bench: A Unified Benchmark for Evaluating and Advancing Efficient Reasoning in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the efficiency of reasoning capabilities in Large Language Models across mathematical, logical, and commonsense tasks. It introduces a new benchmark (EffiReason-Bench) and metric (E3-Score) but does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethical systems.
